title: Entity Campaign enforces its tenant-scoped identity, invariant and lifecycle for consumers
risk: A consumer reads or writes Campaign through a path that crosses the tenant boundary or ignores the invariant, so a wrong or foreign record becomes the basis of a customer-facing statement.
preconditions: Tenant T1 seeded in run-t1-unit-ent-campaign with the fixture record for Campaign identified by its business key
A tenant T2 record with an equivalent business key exists so cross-tenant reads can be attempted

inputs.invariant_under_test: lifecycle runs draft, scheduled, running, completed and dispatch is gated by consent and send-window rules
inputs.refused_violation: a dispatch without a consent check or outside the 09:00-21:00 window is blocked
inputs.downstream_consumer_read: the campaign detail reports state plus the consent-checked recipient count

steps.action: Read and re-write the Campaign record through the tenant-scoped repository/service using the fixture business key
steps.expected: the record round-trips with tenant_id T1, an immutable id and the business key intact

steps.action: Exercise the consumer path named for this entity
steps.expected: the consumer observes the invariant: lifecycle runs draft, scheduled, running, completed and dispatch is gated by consent and send-window rules
the write is rejected with an explicit domain error and leaves no partial row, no orphan child and no side effect (a dispatch without a consent check or outside the 09:00-21:00 window is blocked)

steps.action: Repeat the read with the T2 tenant scope and with a caller lacking authority for this entity
steps.expected: T1 data is not returned, the T2 copy is unchanged and the denial is recorded rather than silently emptied

assertions: The persisted record carries tenant_id T1 and unique identity under (tenant_id, campaign_code)
The consumer path reflects the invariant: lifecycle runs draft, scheduled, running, completed and dispatch is gated by consent and send-window rules
The refused operation returns an explicit error naming the rule, and the prior state is byte-identical afterwards: a dispatch without a consent check or outside the 09:00-21:00 window is blocked
The T2 read returns no T1 row and the T1 read returns no T2 row
forbidden: Accepting the refused operation, or applying it partially before the error: a dispatch without a consent check or outside the 09:00-21:00 window is blocked
Returning, joining or counting another tenant's row on any consumer path of Campaign
evidence: Repository read/write responses for both tenants including the business-key and tenant_id fields
Error code and message of the refused operation plus the unchanged row snapshot taken before and after
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped Campaign rows and their child rows under run-t1-unit-ent-campaign; keep the fixture and the denial audit entry
automation: Drive the repository/service API with the fixture payloads and assert on the returned projection, the error code of the violation and the cross-tenant read; the entity contract is enforced at the service boundary, so no DDL introspection is needed.
